guides.title: How to Make a Roblox Game
guides.description: From downloading Roblox Studio to publishing your first game live — no coding or experience needed. Covers building with free models, setting your age rating, and going public.

guides.title: What Does "Projected" Mean on Rolimons?
guides.description: A projected item has artificially inflated RAP — it looks valuable but sells for a fraction of the price. Learn to spot the warning tag and what to do if you have one.

guides.title: How to Get Admin in EVERY Roblox Game
guides.description: 6 methods that actually work — and method #5 is so obvious nobody ever talks about it. No downloads, no scams, no getting your account stolen.

guides.title: How to Remove Viruses From Your Roblox Game
guides.description: Free model viruses can lag your game, create fake gamepasses, or give exploiters full server access. Here's how to find and delete them in Roblox Studio.

guides.title: How to Stop Hackers and Exploiters in Your Roblox Game
guides.description: Kick them on the spot, ban them permanently, and install a free anti-cheat so they can never come back. Plus: how to fix the real root cause.

guides.title: What Is Roblox Plus? Everything You Need to Know
guides.description: Roblox's new $4.99/month subscription replaces Premium on April 30, 2026. 10-20% off items, free private servers, free Robux transfers, and full trading marketplace access.
